# Test fixtures

## Committed: synthetic fixtures

Each supplier directory has a `synthetic.pdf` + `synthetic.expected.json`,
generated by that directory's `generate_synthetic.py`. These match the real
format's page size, column geometry, letterhead strings, and letter-spaced
headers closely enough to exercise the real parser code end to end, but every
product name, price, and code in them is fabricated. Safe to publish.

Regenerate after a deliberate parser change:

    cd pricelistparser
    uv run python tests/fixtures/van_whole/generate_synthetic.py
    uv run pricelistparser tests/fixtures/van_whole/synthetic.pdf \
        --supplier van_whole --pretty > tests/fixtures/van_whole/synthetic.expected.json

## Local only: real supplier PDFs

You can drop a real historical price-list PDF in the matching supplier
directory (e.g. `van_whole/2026-08-24.pdf`) to sanity-check the parser against
real data. `.gitignore` excludes everything in this tree except the files
listed above, so this never gets committed. There's no test wired to a real
fixture by convention — if you want one while iterating locally, point a
throwaway script or an ad hoc pytest at the file directly.
